title: 경북도, AI 돌봄 지원 로봇 127대 시범 보급 나섰다
summary: Gyeongsangbuk-do is piloting 127 AI care-support robots across 12 childcare centers and after-school care facilities from May 26 to 29, using funds raised for low-birthrate countermeasures and with Gyeongbuk Technopark as the implementing body. title: NC AI, 국방 피지컬AI 국책과제 선정…‘월드모델’로 국방 AX 선도
summary: NC AI and Hyundai Rotem were selected by South Korea’s Agency for Defense Development to lead a national R&D project on a physical-AI-based integrated simulator and modular robot system for defense. The effort is aimed at future battlefields with manned-unmanned teaming, using world-model-style simulation and robotic infrastructure to improve how autonomous defense systems are trained, tested, and deployed.
